name: v0.5.0
body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v0.5.0 -->

## What's Changed
### Other Changes
* feat(smc86): expand modern Intel SMC key coverage + add keys/info subcmds by @hjh1990 in https://github.com/ljh-sh/macli/pull/71
* build(deps): bump actions/checkout from 6.0.3 to 7.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/ljh-sh/macli/pull/65
* docs(changelog): set v0.4.3 release date by @edwinjhlee in https://github.com/ljh-sh/macli/pull/72
* fix(cli): reject unknown flags and rename monitor --metrics to --metric by @edwinjhlee in https://github.com/ljh-sh/macli/pull/70
* build(deps): bump actions/upload-pages-artifact from 3.0.1 to 5.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/ljh-sh/macli/pull/66
* build(deps): bump actions/setup-node from 4.1.0 to 6.4.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/ljh-sh/macli/pull/67
* build(deps): bump softprops/action-gh-release from 3.0.0 to 3.0.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/ljh-sh/macli/pull/68
* build(deps): bump actions/configure-pages from 5.0.0 to 6.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/ljh-sh/macli/pull/69
* docs: document org-level defaults and ljh-sh-default-main ruleset by @edwinjhlee in https://github.com/ljh-sh/macli/pull/74
* docs: move org-level governance notes to mneme AGENTS.md by @edwinjhlee in https://github.com/ljh-sh/macli/pull/77
* feat(battery): expose all IOKit battery fields and add detailed docs by @edwinjhlee in https://github.com/ljh-sh/macli/pull/78
* chore(release): add v0.5.0 changelog by @edwinjhlee in https://github.com/ljh-sh/macli/pull/79

## New Contributors
* @hjh1990 made their first contribution in https://github.com/ljh-sh/macli/pull/71

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ljh-sh/macli/compare/v0.4.3...v0.5.0
